plan.title: Remove an item in the eRFX drawer

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Apply the default offered template before adding line items.
Add the two items required by the scenario.
Remove one item from the Manage Line Items drawer and save the change.
Verify that the saved event now shows exactly one item.
